APP.TITLE: Waiting Games
APP.DESCRIPTION: Hands-free games to watch while you wait. Think of your answer, then watch it be revealed.

STATUS.UP_NEXT: Get ready for the next round

CUPS.SHUFFLING: Keep your eyes on the cup…
CUPS.GUESS_HINT: Think of left, middle or right.

SETTINGS.TITLE: Settings
SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: Playback pauses while this window is open and picks up where it left off when you close it. Changes apply from the next phase that starts; the phase on screen keeps its length.
SETTINGS.TIMING_HELP: Every round runs Watch, then Think, then Answer, then a short pause before the next round. These three times can be changed.

THINKING.LABEL: Thinking time
THINKING.HELP: How long viewers get to think of an answer before it is revealed.

REVEAL.LABEL: Answer reveal time
REVEAL.HELP: How long the correct answer and its explanation stay on screen.

BREAK.LABEL: Time between rounds
BREAK.HELP: The pause after an answer is revealed, before the next round begins.
